portable.integer: Sequential exact int32 dot at full K256/1024; no overflow for codes[-127,127]
portable.attention: BF16 operands rounded RNE, sequential FP32 dot with K64 chunk accumulation
portable.nonlinear: std/libm FP32 LayerNorm, erf GELU, softmax, tanh

physical_design_source.hls_engine: AieTiles AXI stream adapter, not CpuTiles
physical_design_source.integer_kernel: aie::mmul<4,16,8,int8,int8,acc32>,16 K steps, native int32 result
physical_design_source.nonlinear: hls_math functions under BERT_HLS; RTL approximation remains separately qualified

limits: Native BF16 mmul summation and scalar CpuTiles summation are mathematically comparable but not promised bit-identical.
Portable corpus equality does not establish native AIE or RTL numerical identity or performance.
Actual simulator/RTL comparisons must validate packet packing, BF16 error and nonlinear arithmetic separately.
